name: console-03-clients
prompt: Turn this into a different screen of the same console, edge to edge with no browser window. Keep exactly: the left sidebar (the S logo, "Smart-Clearance", "Console", the navigation list with "Clients" selected, and Neha Kulkarni at the bottom) and the visual system. Replace the whole main area, top to bottom: no client header, no tabs, no agent list and no side panel remain. Main area: 1) A large title "Clients", a search field "Search clients, addresses, people" and a dark green button "New client" on the right. 2) A white card holding a table with sortable column headers "Client", "Workspace", "Plan", "Status", "Distributors", "SKUs", "Agents", "Recovered". One row: an orange rounded tile with a white letter m and "Munchly Foods · Pune", "munchly.smartclearance.com" in small monospace, "Pilot", a small green "Live" pill, "4", "8", "10 of 10 on", "₹21,152". 3) Below it, a large calm empty-state card filling the rest of the page: on the left a small tilt-shift miniature diorama photograph of a tiny empty floating island of Indian town with a small folded flat cardboard carton on it, waiting; on the right the heading "Only Munchly is set up so far." and the line "Set up the next manufacturer from its supply-chain profile: route to market, who owns the stock, expiry policy, exits." and a dark green button "New client". Crisp flat interface with one small diorama photo; all text legible.
postprocess: WebP; the PNG original stays local in .impeccable/mocks/
use: SC-25 design board: Console clients list: one row for Munchly Foods, Pune, at munchly.smartclearance.com, Pilot, Live, 4 distributors, 8 SKUs, 10 of 10 agents on, ₹21,152 recovered; below, an empty state with a small floating island and a New client button.
